URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-three-died-ukraine-drone-attack-moscow-region-governor-says-2026-05-17/
TITLE: Ukraine drones kill four in Russia, Moscow faces biggest attack in over a year
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-17 (updated 2026-05-18 01:22 GMT)
SOURCE: Reuters

KEY FACTS:
- Ukraine launched biggest overnight drone attack on Moscow capital in over a year — Sunday
- At least 4 killed: 3 in Moscow region, 1 in Belgorod region
- Russian defence ministry: 1,000+ Ukrainian drones downed in 24h
- Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin: 81 drones destroyed heading for Moscow since midnight
- 12 people wounded near Moscow oil refinery entrance; 3 houses damaged; refinery "technology" undamaged
- Moscow regional Governor Andrei Vorobyov: woman killed when home hit in Khimki north of capital; 2 men killed in Pogorelki, Mytishchi district
- Moscow's Sheremetyevo airport: drone debris fell, no damage

UKRAINIAN MILITARY GENERAL STAFF:
- One strike triggered fire at plant outside Moscow producing high-precision weapons
- Command point overseeing drone flights hit in Russian-occupied Donetsk region

ZELENSKIY:
- "Our responses to Russia's prolongation of the war and its attacks on our cities and communities are entirely justified"
- "We are clearly telling the Russians: Their state must end its war"
- Ukraine struck targets >500 km from border despite dense Russian air defences around Moscow
- "A change in the balance of actions at the front, which is now tangible"

CONTEXT:
- Russia's foreign ministry spokeswoman Zakharova: "To the sound of Eurovision songs, the Kyiv regime, financed by the EU, carried out yet another mass terrorist attack"
- Both sides deny deliberately targeting civilians
- Follows Russia's heaviest drone/missile attack on Kyiv (Friday — 24 killed in apartment bloc)
